Hello! I'd be happy to help you determine your eligibility for Child Benefit. I can see you're asking about two children - Alex (17 years old) and Blake (20 years old), and you all live in the UK.

Let me gather some information to assess your eligibility for each child.

**Regarding Alex (17 years old):**
You mentioned Alex is fostered. This is an important detail - for fostered children, you can get Child Benefit as long as the local council is **not** paying anything towards their accommodation or maintenance. 

Could you please clarify: **Does the local council pay towards Alex's accommodation or maintenance?** This is crucial for determining eligibility for Alex.

**Regarding Blake (20 years old):**
For children aged 20 or over, Child Benefit normally only continues if they are under 20 and in approved education or training. Since Blake is 20 years old, they would generally not be eligible unless they turned 20 while still in approved education (in which case benefit can continue until they finish that course or turn 20, whichever comes first).

Is Blake currently in any approved education or training, or have they recently turned 20 while in education?

Once I have these clarifications, I'll be able to give you a clear assessment of your eligibility for Child Benefit for both children.
